ksp_mappings.explanation: Workflow productivity contributes to the highest-scoring office prompts through visible contracts, invoices, forms, meeting packets, project documentation, and shared office desks.
Enterprise security is source-relevant but mostly omitted from prompt text because security policies and governance are not visible ordinary tabletop materials.
Fleet integration and lifecycle adaptability supports the general managed-office context but is not forced into scenes as unnatural deployment props or labels.
Sustainability is omitted from prompts because environmental credentials are not an ordinary visible lifestyle scene cue for this camera view.

value_proposition.explanation: Both documents position the product around managed enterprise document workflows, shared workteams, and business-critical office output. The prompt set translates that into ordinary office desks with simple document stacks where camera limits allow, while keeping other C-Tech environments as lower-scoring style alternatives.

debug.input_assessment: The smart brief and source messaging strongly support enterprise and shared office document settings, especially contracts, invoices, forms, meeting packets, project documentation, and managed workteams. They do not support home, education, gaming, café, or creative studio as primary use environments; those categories are included only for required diversity and are labeled as adjacent or creative departures.
debug.count_explanation: Generated exactly 20 distinct prompt texts. The bank covers Home, Office, Education, Gaming, Café, and Creative Studio while respecting the resolved tight camera limits of at most one local prop, zero background details, and no people.
ignored_fields: Runtime metadata, run identifiers, status fields, creation/export timestamps, and model labels were not used as scene evidence.
Search-position and AI visibility data were treated as positioning context only, not product or lifestyle scene facts.
Claims, disclaimers, speed figures, security feature names, and sustainability certifications were not turned into visible props.
debug.diversity_summary: The highest-relevance prompts are office-led because both sources emphasize managed enterprise document workflows. Additional C-Tech-led alternatives include café tables, creative office tables, home surfaces, gaming desks, and education tables, all simplified for the tight close-up camera.
limitations: The selected camera allows only one local prop and no background details, so many reference room elements were omitted.
The target device is intentionally excluded from prompt text.
Security, fleet management, firmware, connectivity, and sustainability claims are not visually represented because they would be abstract or device-dependent.
Home, café, education, gaming, and creative studio prompts are less source-grounded because the source documents focus on enterprise office workflows.
